podcast.body: Aretha Franklin performed this challenging tenor aria from Puccini's opera "Turandó" at the Grammy Awards on February 25, 1998, stepping in for Luciano Pavarotti with less than an hour's notice. She had only previously performed it at a Music Care's event a few nights prior, but her live telecast rendition was a vocal masterclass, restrained and subtle before blasting into the aria's infamously high top note. "It was a vocal masterclass restrained and subtle when needed before blasting into space on the arias infamously high top note at the climax."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
